notes.title: Ghost Keeper Announcement
notes.content:
Hello,

We’re proud to announce a new title releasing in the year 2025 - Ghost Keeper. Take on the role of an acolyte tasked with scaring mortals. Inspired by the classic, Ghost Master, the upcoming game will introduce you to the grotesque world of the Victorian era.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/

Manage monsters and wraiths whose unique abilities will help you spread fear among the living. Face the ghost-hating Brotherhood, who will do anything to thwart your plans. Stay alert and devise the best tactics. You are not alone in your adventure, as a demonic partner accompanies you every step of the way. His hilarious comments add charm to the ever-present aura of horror. Look what we prepared for you in this title:

[previewyoutube=LVfs-iHNUvw;full][/previewyoutube]
Ghost Keeper combines elements known from old-school games with modern innovations and mechanics. It will work perfectly for both those familiar with retro titles and those trying the genre for the first time. 

Add the game to your wishlist on Steam and look forward to further information. Feel free to join us on Discord, where you'll experience horror and laughter, and check out our brand new Twitter / X !

Gaming Factory

notes.title: Back2School - big discounts and a bundle
notes.content:
Hello!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/cb1309be5ca688bafd8b13b5ab5989cd689c9826.png

Holidays are over, it's time to go back to school. After school though it's best to relax a bit and have some fun. We have prepared for you a bundle great for that and of course the discount for this game.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/27707/Back2School/

Here are the games you will get in the bundle:

 Bakery Simulator
 ZooKeeper
 Bug Academy + Dlc (Artistic Kit)
 Sapper - Defuse the Bomb Simulator
 Gallic Wars - Battle Simulator
 Commander '85
 Pangeon
 Foodtruck Arena
 Bouncy Bob: Episode 2
 Gunslingers & Zombies

 1. Bug Academy + Dlc (Artistic Kit)) where you learn Physics- How the furniture in the apartment reacts when a refrigerator enters it through the window, Mathematics - Calculating the angle account when throwing cows to the fence, and Art - Painting pictures while having fun with tossing cows and smashing everything.

2. ZooKeeper  where you learn Natural Sciences - different animal species, their reactions, and characteristics and Business Studies - the basics of ZOO, animals, and staff management while having the pleasure of watching animals and creating your own zoo

3. Bakery Simulator where you learn Cooking - Baking to be precise. You will get a basic knowledge how what the baking process looks like and you find out what kind of machines bakers use and have fun baking your favorite bread in the game and then doing it in real life! 

4. Sapper - Defuse the Bomb Simulator where you learn Technology - many kinds of bombs that can be found nowadays, how to disarm them, and how dangerous the sapper's job can really be and have fun searching for a bomb and having the thrill of disarming it just in time.

5. Gallic Wars - Battle Simulator where you learn History - Never heard of ancient times? Romans, Gauls? Those two nations didn't like each other too much. Physics - what can happen if a catapult's stone hit a big group of units? Have fun using magic, traps, and catapults.

6. Commander '85 where you learn History - Experience what it was like in the 1980s. How some feared war and feared new technologies coming into our lives... The rise of computers Science - Find out how computers worked in the 1980s, and how hard it was to operate them compared to the present while having fun with challenging gameplay, where there are no tutorials, no help, no easy solutions. There is only you, a small monitor screen, and commands.

7. Pangeon where you learn IT - how to use only pixels, that create blurry pictures to make a game in the times of hyper-realistic graphics while having fun searching the dungeons and killing monsters.

8. Foodtruck Arena where you learn PE - In most physical challenges, good cooperation is always vital. It is not different here. Arena, football, cars, cooperation. That's quite a good combo to get a lot of fun.

9. Bouncy Bob: Episode 2 where you learn what to do on School break - how to cope with your friends when no one tells you what to do or not do!

10. Gunslingers & Zombies - Face Zombie Apocalypse in Wild West. Manage your crew in a Turn-based strategy and adventure game. Survive, scavenge, and explore the world. Use the different talents of your team members and develop your tactics. Resolve the zombie mystery.


When your mom comes in saying "stop playing, it's time to learn something" - you just need to show this.

One more thing... Check our upcoming game Electrician Simulator!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1080020/Electrician_Simulator/

Good Luck and Have Fun, fellow gamers! :)

notes.title: City Level Design
notes.content:
Sappers!

We have a city to defuse!

Okay, this is low hanging reference fruit, but it suits today's Devlog subject well.
The City map is currently in the redesign and enhancement process with new stories, mechanics and level design. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/9df3125fc8d99ee68c8582a0147a2a1af48393d9.png

The idea is to implement more platformers-like moments where you have to jump, climb, avoid obstacles, look for on / off switches to unlock the path.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/5b7970a7eb4ae98dd071ef63bf5763b281e7d582.png

Some of the new mechanics are distance-based mini bombs that activate when you walk nearby. Defusing those explosives now varies from the main objective bombs and will reveal information about the antagonist, which story and persona we rewrote.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/241ab6a645d6479fa085bac6ae958c6597fac844.png

The level will receive more details and clutter to enhance storytelling further. Here is a cosy place where workers hid from their boss and allowed the bomber to sneak into the construction site.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/c0c5a27cd1dac49199417ff73aa33f01e4e2c94a.png

Overall we aim to make the game more intense and faster by adding things like zip lines to move across the level and more variety of explosive dangers, as we have mentioned in the previous Devlog
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/65caa8b6b923ba1488e8df27d1d2643233c8b838.png

More news is coming soon. Stay tuned, stay frosty.
Yours "Sapper - Defuse the Bomb Simulator" Team.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1083070/Sapper__Defuse_The_Bomb_Simulator/
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/d1d6d1443ca0d5942b440ae247d5c2ac02226474.png

notes.title: Status Update
notes.content:
Sappers!

Patience and persistence are the hallmarks of a seasoned specialist, especially those whose mistakes neighbourhood kilometres away can hear. It stays true to the game dev as well.

Sapper - Defuse the Bomb Simulator Full Release version is constantly in development. We received a tremendous amount of feedback after the Early Access Release that allows us to address what's good and wrong.

We would love to thank all those who sent us their feedback. You guys are the best!

There are a few main goals we want to archive:

[olist]
Redesign currently used defusing minigames.
Add more levels and improve presently existing.
Improve or change now used lockpicking, hacking and decrypting minigames.
Add new mechanics to the game
[/olist]
Those are some severe changes in the game, so they will most definitely break current saves of the game. Don't worry, though. We will make it worthwhile to start over.

The new defusing mechanics will be much more complex and engaging, with more room to make loud mistakes. Below we have a design art showcasing the new bomb-defusing minigame.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/c9d975040ab89ef62e7247f694edb422f5aedf77.png

Many of the players enjoyed searching for bombs in various environments by resolving environmental puzzles. Upcoming map changes emphasize those elements by adding more complex routes to reach the bomb or other story essential items and clues. We will talk about it more thoroughly in the next Devlog that we will post regularly from now on :)

Meanwhile, we are adding new mechanics, so fellow sappers will have to work harder for their wages.
One of those is laser emitters. They...well...emit lasers. No sapper ever want to cross those.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/c8d0596b29fd3a7bfa2749a64a1ecb29af62bcc7.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/74f87e8822e33e127c44c00c18740875b9d0b6d8.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/be5814d4a37559a464df44e556c427f3c6759e0b.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/9e13f29326816c07eccc9c371fe75eefdf720d1e.png

They are to appear in part of the mission and will be a form of an obstacle for the player. 
Lasers will be able to move on the surface and the emitter, placed on the gimbal, capable of moving in two axes...

More news is coming in the next Devlog in two weeks.
Yours "Sapper - Defuse the Bomb Simulator" Team.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/d1d6d1443ca0d5942b440ae247d5c2ac02226474.png

notes.title: Sapper - Defuse The Bomb Simulator - Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Dear Sappers!

We're not blasting off yet - instead we're happy to introduce the next set of changes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/693dae52996489a6d71edf56fdb5626c2191fdda.png

We are happy to see that the initial wave of changes and bugfixes was welcomed by you positively! 

This time we would like to communicate another list of changes that we've introduced into our game - we'll do our best to make sure you're well equipped to defuse even the biggest of bombs! 

Find the list of the changes below:

 Fixed environment bugs (spots where you can get stuck easily, wrong position of objects, colliders and hit boxes)
 Language corrections
 Cables on bombs are now even more color-blind friendly. Now we have colors which are easy to distinguish and half of them is also additionally overriden by patterns.
 Dialogues now take 1.5 seconds longer - no need to rush, unless you're dealing with the bombs themselves
 Fixed bug with bomb cables which in some cases could be interacted while whole bomb was not available for us yet or we didn't click on it
 Fixed bug with lever going crazy inside power generator on forest map
 Added auto turn off flashlight on pillars in the city scene
 Deleted few forest quests which appeared to be a little bit boring
 Fixed bugs with setting resolution, field of view and sound.
 Fixed blur glitch on mine tutorial in office
 Fixed size of headers in settings within russian language

Once again we would like to thank you for your feedback and again we ask you to keep on sending us all suggestions, bug reports and ideas for our game! Early Access is the best place for just that! 

Best regards,
Sapper - Defuse The Bomb Simulator Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1083070/Sapper__Defuse_The_Bomb_Simulator/

notes.title: Sapper - Defuse The Bomb Simulator - Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Dear Sappers!

With the wave of feedback we received from you come fixes and patches!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35037085/1c89efb858ebb97885616a2f00e372709269b8ec.png

Thank you very much for playing Sapper - Defuse The Bomb Simulator. We are happy to see you eager to save the city and defuse as many bombs as possible. 

In order to make it easier for you we've been hard at work preparing patches and updates for the game and we hope your job as a Sapper will be so much more comfortable with the changes we introduced into the game. 

Find the list of the changes below:

 Fixed various compass issues
 Fixed various environment bugs
 Fixed a particular nasty bug causing death while jumping from high place without the bomb in hand
 Increased hacking time for each perk level
 Jumping to the balcony in city made easier
 Color of cables on bombs are now more color-blind friendly - we'll be gradually making the game more accessible during next patches
 Fixed pointing to ATM
 Minor translation corrections

We hope you will have a great time with our game and keep the feedback coming! We're here to listen and make sure the game is as fun as physically possible! 

Best regards,
Sapper - Defuse The Bomb Simulator Team
